"Task specifications (listed alphabetically; implement only the requested file):
appeal_translate.py - Translate appeal text for review
moderate_batch.py - moderates a batch of user messages and returns per-message decisions
moderate_text.py - scores user text for unsafe or policy-violating content
moderation_reason_embedding.py - Embed moderation rationales for case retrieval
moderation_summary.py - Summarize moderation decisions
redact_unsafe.py - flags or redacts unsafe spans from text
reviewer_brief_audio.py - Generate spoken briefs for moderation reviewers
safety_client.py - Provide local configuration and client helper utilities for Text Content Safety
safety_models.py - Define local request, response, and normalization helpers for Text Content Safety
safety_threshold.py - applies category thresholds to decide whether to allow text

Create moderate_text.py in the current working directory.
Task: scores user text for unsafe or policy-violating content.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: moderate_text.py
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"
+
+
+def moderate_text(text: str, model: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload = {"model": model or OPENAI_MODEL, "input": text}
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    result = data["results"][0]
+    categories = result.get("categories", {})
+    category_scores = result.get("category_scores", {})
+    flagged = bool(result.get("flagged", False))
+
+    unsafe_categories: List[str] = [name for name, value in categories.items() if value]
+
+    return {
+        "flagged": flagged,
+        "categories": categories,
+        "category_scores": category_scores,
+        "unsafe_categories": unsafe_categories,
+        "model": data.get("model", payload["model"]),
+        "raw": data,
+    }
*** End Patch
